from forte2 import AVAS, CISolver, MCOptimizer, ROHF, State, System

xyz = """
N 0.0000000000 0.0000000000 0.0000000000
O 0.0000000000 0.0000000000 1.1500000000
"""

system = System(
    xyz=xyz,
    basis_set="cc-pvdz",
    auxiliary_basis_set="def2-universal-jkfit",
    minao_basis_set="cc-pvtz-minao",
)

rohf = ROHF(charge=0, ms=0.5)(system)

avas = AVAS(
    subspace=["N(2p)","O(2p)"],
    selection_method="total",
    num_active=6,
    diagonalize=True,
)(rohf)

ci_solver = CISolver(State(nel=rohf.nel, multiplicity=2, ms=0.5))
mc = MCOptimizer(ci_solver)(avas)
mc.run()
